text_block_list.text: During a dance lesson with Manhattan Cafe――
(—Swipe... —swipe...)

The dance moves seem natural to her body,
but somehow, they don't quite match the music...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Is it... unnatural after all?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Should I try matching the music more...?
Or should we change the song altogether...?"
choice_data_list: Let's try to keep things cheerful
Let's try changing the song to a ballad.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
All right... I'll give it a try.
Cheerfully...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Whoa... What the heck are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur-san, what a coincidence...
Did you come here to dance as well...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about that crap.
More importantly, that dance from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Moving all briskly with a scowl on your face...
That ain't like you at all."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Think logically. Statistically speakin', what is it that your fans actually want from ya?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, it ain't that kind of cheap flattery.
Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............
Indeed, that is quite true...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I can see... the path I must take.
Shakur-san... thank you for your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah!? It's not consideration!
That weird dance you did earlier was just throwing me off!"

In any case, thanks to Air Shakur,
I felt like I could see our path forward.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A ballad, is it...?
Indeed, if it's that—

What is this...? Watching her dance,
my eyelids are getting heavier and heavier—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
A gentle, leisurely melody...
with a somewhat sorrowful ring to it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...It feels so comforting, doesn't it?
For a while after that, Manhattan Cafe continued to dance...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...?
This is the dance studio, but...

Before I knew it, I was back in the dance studio.
While watching Manhattan Cafe dance,
I seemed to have wandered into a world of illusions...
